_comment: Local API logging: uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --log-config uvicorn_log.json (run from the repo root).
Why: the terminal scrollback was the only record of a demo, so a failed LLM stage (Translator failed / Rerank failed) could not be traced afterwards.
app.*, uvicorn.error and the root logger -> console + logs/api.log (rotating, 5 MB x 3; logs/ is gitignored).

The file handler is app.log_handlers.SharedRotatingFileHandler: with --reload/--workers, or two servers run from the repo root, several processes hold logs/api.log, and on Windows the stock RotatingFileHandler then lost every record past 5 MB (it cannot rename a file another process has open). This one keeps appending and retries the rotation a minute later.
uvicorn.access -> console ONLY: its request lines carry the query in the URL, and safety.md keeps query text out of log files.
The make_logs_dir 'filter' is os.makedirs(logs, exist_ok=True): dictConfig builds filters before handlers, so a fresh clone (no logs/) still starts. No handler uses it.
Console output looks as before: uvicorn lines in uvicorn's own format, app lines in the format app/main.py's basicConfig used (a no-op once this config has set root handlers).
